cache_dir.description: Path to a directory in which a downloaded pretrained model configuration should be cached if the standard cache should not be used

config.description: Can be either an instance of a class derived from `PretrainedConfig`, or a string or path valid as input to `~PretrainedConfig.from_pretrained`

anyOf.description: dict[str, Union[int, str, torch.device]] or int or torch.device

dtype.description: torch.dtype to load the model in (e.g. torch.float16, torch.bfloat16, torch.float)

force_download.description: Whether or not to force the (re-)download of the model weights and configuration files, overriding the cached versions if they exist

from_flax.description: Load the model weights from a Flax checkpoint save file (see docstring of `pretrained_model_name_or_path` argument)

from_tf.description: Load the model weights from a TensorFlow checkpoint save file (see docstring of `pretrained_model_name_or_path` argument)

ignore_mismatched_sizes.description: Whether or not to raise an error if some of the weights from the checkpoint do not have the same size as the weights of the model

key_mapping.description: A potential mapping of the weight names.

max_memory.description: A dictionary device identifier to maximum memory if using `device_map`.

model_args.description: All remaining positional arguments will be passed to the underlying model's __init__ method

output_loading_info.description: Whether ot not to also return a dictionary containing missing keys, unexpected keys and error messages

pretrained_model_name_or_path.description: Can be either a string, the model id of a pretrained model hosted inside a model repo on huggingface.co, or a path to a directory containing model weights saved using `~PreTrainedModel.save_pretrained`

proxies.description: A dictionary of proxy servers to use by protocol or endpoint

variant.description: load weights from variant filename (e.g. pytorch_model.<variant>.bin)

bad_words_ids.description: List of list of token ids that are not allowed to be generated

begin_suppress_tokens.description: A list of tokens that will be suppressed at the beginning of the generation. The `SuppressBeginTokens` logit processor will set their log probs to `-inf` so that they are not sampled

cache_config.description: Arguments used in the key-value cache class can be passed in `cache_config`

cache_implementation.description: Name of the cache class that will be instantiated in `generate`, for faster decoding

decoder_start_token_id.description: If an encoder-decoder model starts decoding with a different token than *bos*, the id of that token or a list of length `batch_size`. Indicating a list enables different start ids for each element in the batch (e.g. multilingual models with different target languages in one batch)

do_sample.description: Whether or not to use sampling ; use greedy decoding otherwise

early_stopping.description: Controls the stopping condition for beam-based methods, like beam-search

encoder_no_repeat_ngram_size.description: If set to int > 0, all ngrams of that size that occur in the `encoder_input_ids` cannot occur in the `decoder_input_ids`

eos_token_id.description: The id of the *end-of-sequence* token. Optionally, use a list to set multiple *end-of-sequence* tokens

epsilon_cutoff.description: If set to float strictly between 0 and 1, only tokens with a conditional probability greater than `epsilon_cutoff` will be sampled

eta_cutoff.description: Eta sampling is a hybrid of locally typical sampling and epsilon sampling. If set to float strictly between 0 and 1, a token is only considered if it is greater than either `eta_cutoff` or `sqrt(eta_cutoff) * exp(-entropy(softmax(next_token_logits)))`

exponential_decay_length_penalty.description: This Tuple adds an exponentially increasing length penalty, after a certain amount of tokens have been generated

forced_bos_token_id.description: The id of the token to force as the first generated token after the `decoder_start_token_id`

forced_eos_token_id.description: The id of the token to force as the last generated token when `max_length` is reached. Optionally, use a list to set multiple *end-of-sequence* tokens

guidance_scale.description: The guidance scale for classifier free guidance (CFG). CFG is enabled by setting `guidance_scale > 1`

is_assistant.description: Whether the model is an assistant (draft) model

length_penalty.description: Exponential penalty to the length that is used with beam-based generation

max_length.description: The maximum length the generated tokens can have

max_new_tokens.description: The maximum numbers of tokens to generate, ignoring the number of tokens in the prompt

max_time.description: The maximum amount of time you allow the computation to run for in seconds

min_length.description: The minimum length of the sequence to be generated

min_new_tokens.description: The minimum numbers of tokens to generate, ignoring the number of tokens in the prompt

min_p.description: Minimum token probability, which will be scaled by the probability of the most likely token

no_repeat_ngram_size.description: If set to int > 0, all ngrams of that size can only occur once

num_assistant_tokens.description: Defines the number of _speculative tokens_ that shall be generated by the assistant model before being checked by the target model at each iteration

num_beams.description: Number of beams for beam search. 1 means no beam search

num_return_sequences.description: The number of independently computed returned sequences for each element in the batch

output_attentions.description: Whether or not to return the attentions tensors of all attention layers

output_hidden_states.description: Whether or not to return the hidden states of all layers

output_logits.description: Whether or not to return the unprocessed prediction logit scores

output_scores.description: Whether or not to return the prediction scores

remove_invalid_values.description: Whether to remove possible *nan* and *inf* outputs of the model to prevent the generation method to crash

renormalize_logits.description: Whether to renormalize the logits after applying all the logits processors (including the custom ones)

return_dict_in_generate.description: Whether or not to return a [`~utils.ModelOutput`], as opposed to returning exclusively the generated sequence

return_legacy_cache.description: Whether to return the legacy or new format of the cache when `DynamicCache` is used by default

sequence_bias.description: Dictionary that maps a sequence of tokens to its bias term

stop_strings.description: A string or a list of strings that should terminate generation if the model outputs them

suppress_tokens.description: A list of tokens that will be suppressed at generation. The `SuppressTokens` logit processor will set their log probs to `-inf` so that they are not sampled

temperature.description: The value used to module the next token probabilities

token_healing.description: Heal tail tokens of prompts by replacing them with their appropriate extensions. This enhances the quality of completions for prompts affected by greedy tokenization bias

top_k.description: The number of highest probability vocabulary tokens to keep for top-k-filtering

top_p.description: If set to float < 1, only the smallest set of most probable tokens with probabilities that add up to `top_p` or higher are kept for generation

typical_p.description: Local typicality measures how similar the conditional probability of predicting a target token next is to the expected conditional probability of predicting a random token next, given the partial text already generated

use_cache.description: Whether or not the model should use the past last key/values attentions (if applicable to the model) to speed up decoding

watermarking_config.description: Arguments used to watermark the model outputs by adding a small bias to randomly selected set of "green" tokens
